conclusion: degree sequences exist; necessary, never sufficient
boundary: a degree sequence is necessary for a 110-leaf blocker and never sufficient; nothing here bounds tau_2 unless the count is zero and the enumeration is complete
observedRangesAreNotBounds: the supports and maxima fields are what the INCOMPLETE enumeration happened to produce; only provedBounds are facts
headline: at |X|=110 the support is at least 24 on each axis -- the geometry beats the naive counting bound of ceil(110/7)=16 by eight -- and the largest fibre is at least 4, so no tight solution is flat
